item.title: What makes the Nepal's geography so uniquely prone to disasters
item.description: The deadly flooding that struck Nepal this week is not the first disaster that people in the region have endured. The country's unique geography makes it especially prone to natural disasters.

item.title: Judge says the Pentagon can't designate AI company Anthropic a 'supply chain risk'
item.description: A federal judge has ruled that the Pentagon violated Anthropic's first amendment rights when it tried to designate the AI company a supply chain risk earlier this year.

item.description: Scientists collaborated with narwhals for a new study to understand human-caused climate change in the Arctic and rising sea levels around the world.

item.title: Americans traveling to Israel say they are being denied entry to the country
item.description: Lawyers say Israel has increased entry bans to U.S. and foreign visitors who plan to meet with Palestinians or for suspicions about their opinions about Israel.

item.description: NPR's Adrian Florido talks with the co-founder of a newly formed network of independent Black comic book shops across the U.S. They hope to strengthen sales and increase the diversity of comic fans.

item.title: High beef prices got you down? Here's how to eat like a vegetarian
